scope: Ten v644-v8 candidate titles against the 300-record frozen chain.
procedure: Collect the foreach comparison report as an explicit array, compute stop-word-normalized token Jaccard scores, and serialize each candidate's three closest titles.
expected: All ten candidates receive complete ranked comparisons and no candidate is promoted solely from the token screen.
observed: All ten reports completed; the maximum observed title-token Jaccard was 0.3846, and mechanism-level review remains separately required.
boundary: Token similarity is a collision screen, not proof that no paraphrase or semantic overlap exists.
